title: Rewind from controller phase four
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose the forward and find-mode settings, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. For any loop host configuration $c$ whose control state is controller phase four, there is a natural number $t$ with $t\le c$'s input-head position plus $2$ such that after $t$ steps the host has the same configuration data as $c$, except that its control is the startup body-call state with release clear and body state $B$'s initial state, and its input head is at position $1$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean finite machines B and F
c is in controller phase four
replaced:
Let $c$ be a configuration of the loop host in controller phase four. Then there is a
time $t$ at most the input-head position of $c$ plus two after which the host sits in
the startup body-call state with input head at position one and every other component of
$c$ unchanged.
